full_judgment: 5. Mr. Md. Abdus Samad, Senior Advocate with Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record submits that since the unfair relationship with the student is somehow admitted by the plaintiff the question of illegal removal does not, at all, arise. Moreover, the plaintiff has also failed to deposit the part amount collected from the student as a class teacher, as such the impugned order of removal is lawful where no interference can be made by the High Court Division.
